answer: The admission bond is time locked for 24 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in mesa, expire in jetty, and gale lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 12 aliases therefore needs 107 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 733 identities would post 4942 proofs and burn roughly 53 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
